**L1 first review: REWORK (1 item: the out-of-scope stale texts need a #N or an in-place fix; the sharding, the gate change and the prose rewrite are accepted)** · PR #34650 · card #33942 · area o2-C · L1-a2 · 2026-11-17T04:59Z

Head-sha: `1277945da8dd405ce7ff329770428441ef60227d`

Dev report 6938835952 on #33942. ⚠️ At the time of reading, 15 check-runs on this head were still `in_progress` with none red, and there is no final-head comment on the PR yet. The delta read waits for both.

### Checked, no problem

- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #33942` as the only closing keyword. `Fixes` is right: the card's Done-when is the different-package no-conflict proof, and the PR gives it. `skip-changeset` is right: root `scripts/`, `content/docs/**` and `docs/audits/**` ship in no package's `files[]`. Nothing under `content/docs/releases/**`, `skills/**` or `docs/adr/**`. `git show --remerge-diff` on the main merge `1277945d` is empty.
- **Shard key and the proof.** Shards are per package under `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts/{services,plugins}/` (18 files). The index file holds method text and the dated scale block only, with no population figure and no shard list. Both runs of the replay output are in the body: on the sharded base, `merge-tree` exits 0, a fresh `--write` on the merged tree leaves `git status` empty, and the gate passes at 324; the control on `origin/main` 082f9c2945 conflicts on both artefacts. That is the card's bar. Same-package additions still conflict on their shard, and the body says so.
- **Dev question (1), check B: accepted as a forced change, not a weakening.** Old B held each hand-written prose total equal to the census. The card orders those totals out of the prose ("Remove totals from the prose; the gate prints them"), so old B has nothing left to check. New B fails if any of the 12 former shapes reappears (`[prose-total]`).
  - The coverage is the same in both directions. An unknown new wording was unchecked before and is unchecked now. A known wording is now refused instead of held equal.
  - A and C keep their refusals. A gains three drift arms: a stale shard, a package with sites and no shard, and an orphan shard. Its self-test floor rises from 5 to 7. Every census total is a sum of per-package totals, so a moved total is still a red.
  - The order said "existing tests unchanged", which cannot hold for cases whose fixture was a removed page count. The body names each changed case, and the 101 generator classifier cases are unchanged. Each new rule has an on-disk ablation that reds through the real CLI.
- **Dev question (2), the history figures: checked, correct.**
  - The page at `4ecafc78b1` (#13584, 2026-08-31) reads 215 write call sites, **17** provable, **67** unreadable, and "**84** sites carrying no tenant context at all". That matches the new 84 / 17 / 67 sentence and its date.
  - The 51-verdict sentence is already on that page, so its "on 2026-08-31" date holds.
  - "225 → 227 on 2026-09-18" matches `ab41a8f53c` (#19073, 2026-09-18).
  - The removed "exactly one write call site … targets either" contradicted main's own region row, "…declares tenancy off | **7**". Removing it was right, and the new sentence names the total instead of a count.
- **Prose faces of `tenant-audit-census.mdx`, checked sentence by sentence against the gate and generator.**
  - The two new ⛔ paragraphs ("states no live population figure … prints the census totals on every run") match the gate's `totalsRows` print and the body's quoted output.
  - "every package shard … counts the sites reached through an erased receiver" and "Counted in every package shard are the subtractions …" match the shard contents.
  - The deviation table's third column names gate output rows that exist in the printed summary (`Write call sites`, `cite:`, `Object name statically decidable` / `chosen at run time`).
  - "Across 117 declared objects" is kept as the unenforced scale figure under the 2026-08-31 split. That is right.
- **Dev question (3), `--refresh-scale`: accepted.** It is a flag on a repo-internal script, the name is the seat's call (the area keeps it), and `--write` without it keeps the committed scale block. The gate never compared that block.

### R1: the stale texts named in Acceptance notes need a `#N`, or the edit

The Acceptance notes name three texts that this PR makes stale, "noted, not edited":

1. `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`, the `NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED` `docs/audits/**` entry. It describes `2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md` as the generated file that `check-tenant-audit-census.mjs` holds to its `--write` output. It now says nothing of the `.counts/` shard directory, which is the population artefact after this PR.
2. `.gitattributes` near line 106, which describes the page as a generated region plus prose, with the single-file shape.
3. `packages/services/service-settings/src/config-change-audit.ts` around line 163. It justifies leaving an insert inline because folding it "moves … a hand-written prose count", and after this PR that count no longer exists.

An out-of-scope leftover the body names needs a card number or a reason a reviewer can check that it is not a defect. The repo:objectstack#1 L1 required the same on #34539 (R1) and #34513 (R3). Either:

- **(a)** Fix the three in place. They are comment-only, mechanical edits about the same artefact, unclaimed, and in the same gate family. Revise the claim's file surface in a comment and name the edits in the body. Or:
- **(b)** File one finding through filing gate ① for the three and cite its `#N` in Acceptance notes, with no closing verb beside it.

Note: the 2861 changed lines are under the 3000 human-merge line now. Route (a) adds a few lines; recount with `check-governed-merges.mjs`.

### L2 and landing

- **L2: not owed.** `Clause-②: no`, no narrowing, nothing under `packages/spec/src/**` (so not spec surface), and no governed path (`check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 34650`: `✅ NOT governed`).
- **Landing:** ordinary queue landing by the area after the delta ACCEPT on a green final head. No human approval is needed, as long as the PR stays under 3000 changed lines.

### 📓 Docs Drift Check
⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-settings/src/config-change-audit.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files. Nothing else in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)).

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-settings/src/config-change-audit.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8bc080847291127d590cb260215a7ce652603d43` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

The edit is comment-only, so behaviour does not change. **Answered.**
